notes.title: [Important] End of Service Refund Policies and Publication of Unreleased Story
notes.content:
As was recently announced, service for TRIBE NINE will be terminated on 2025/11/27 JST.
We wish to take this opportunity to apologize again for the sudden nature of the announcement.

To provide players with a rewarding experience through game service, we put together a team of roughly 300 people for its development and management.
However, the number of new players joining, along with the number of players playing the game, as well as item sales following the release of Ch. 3 - Neo Chiyoda City all substantially fell below initial projections.

In light of the situation, we determined it would be difficult to maintain the current structure while providing satisfying service for our players.
For that reason, it is with a heavy heart we are announcing the tough decision to disband the TRIBE NINE development / management team and to terminate game service.

Since service commenced, we have received tremendous support from many players; this outcome is a result of our own limitations. We regret the timing of this decision when players are looking forward to future developments based on the roadmap published prior to releasing Ch. 3 - Neo Chiyoda City. We wish to express our deepest apologies once again for this outcome.

[h3] Refund Policies Related to Termination of Service[/h3]

Below, we outline the refund policies that will be implemented as a result of the termination of game service.

[b]■ Refunds for Paid Item Purchases Made After the Publication of the Roadmap[/b]
All paid item purchases made after the publication of the roadmap at 2025/4/10 19:30 JST will be refunded.
*Purchases made with Paid Enigma Entities will not be eligible for refund, with the exception of those related to "Support Contract - Revenio", which will be detailed below.

The following refund methods will be made available to those seeking a refund.[list][*] For purchases made via the App Store and on Google Play: Refund to be wired to PayPal Account / domestic bank account within Japan
[*] For purchases made via Steam and Xsolla (Web Store): Refund to be provided through respective platforms.[/list]

More details regarding the application period and relevant application methods for refund will be provided as soon as they are finalized. We kindly ask for your patience.

[b]■ Refunds for Remaining Unconsumed Paid Enigma Entities in Players' Possession after Termination of Service[/b]
Remaining Paid Enigma Entities in players' possession when service terminates on 2025/11/27 JST will be refunded.
They will be refunded at the highest rate (JPY 2.22/Paid Enigma Entity) no matter the rate of Paid Enigma Entities at the time of purchase.

[b]■ Return of Paid Enigma Entities Used for "Support Contract - Revenio"[/b]
As per the previous notice, the consumed Paid Enigma Entities used to unlock Armed Support and Advanced Support, as well as to purchase Contract Levels for "Support Contract - Revenio" will be returned after "Support Contract - Revenio" ends.
These returned Paid Enigma Entities will be eligible for refund.

More details regarding the application period and relevant application methods for refund of remaining Paid Enigma Entities in players' possession will be provided as soon as they are finalized.

[h3] Publication Plans for Unreleased Story[/h3]

With the disbandment of the development team, we are unfortunately unable to add new story content to the game. Yet, through the effort of the scenario team, we have been working hard to publish story content on the official website up until Ch. 5, which was already in production.

(Please note that the content will be based on character dialogues that were originally scheduled to be released in-game; hence, there may be instances in which the content is difficult to follow as the narration may not be sufficient enough to depict the whole story in detail. We humbly ask for your understanding in advance.)

*This is planned to be released in Japanese only.

Once again, we would like to sincerely apologize for the nature of this notice to all players who are eager to witness how the story of TRIBE NINE would unfold.

Finally, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for all the support for TRIBE NINE from our players.

We hope you will enjoy the story updates that we plan to publish on the official website in the future.

notes.title: [Important] Canceled Update and End of Service Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for continuing to play TRIBE NINE.

We regret to inform you that service for TRIBE NINE will be terminated on 11/27/2025 JST.

Since the game's launch, the development and operation teams have strived to provide excellent service and improve player experience. However, after careful consideration, we have made the difficult decision to end the game's service.

We are unfortunately unable to deliver Ch. 4 of the story, which we had previously announced.
We apologize for the sudden nature of this announcement to our players.

Information regarding the service termination schedule and any related procedures will be made through in-game notices and on the official website.

[h3] Regarding Future Updates and New Content[/h3]
As of 05/14/2025 22:00 GMT-8, all scheduled updates and new content releases have been canceled.

Additionally, new features, adjustments, and known-issue fixes previously announced via in-game notices will not be implemented.

[h3] Regarding Unreleased Characters[/h3]
With the termination of service, the addition of Ichinosuke Akiba and Saizo Akiba to the game, which were originally scheduled on the roadmap, will also be canceled.

Due to this change, the consumption of Paid Enigma Entities used to unlock Armed Support and Advanced Support, as well as to purchase Contract Levels for "Support Contract - Revenio", where Saizo Akiba's Skin could be acquired, will be refunded.

Refunds for Paid Enigma Entities will commence after "Support Contract - Revenio" ends. 

[h3] Purchases of Items within the App or through the Web Store[/h3]
As of 05/14/2025 22:00 GMT-8, paid Enigma Entities and Daily Passes will no longer be sold.
*Enigma Entities will continue to be available for use even after 05/14/2025 22:00 GMT-8.

We hope you will continue to enjoy TRIBE NINE despite the short period of time before service ends on 11/27/2025 JST.

notes.title: [Ver. 1.1.1] Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing TRIBE NINE.
Ver. 1.1.1 has been released.

Along with the Fractal Vice update, a variety of features will be added or updated.

[h3]Updated Content[/h3]

[h3]Fractal Vice updates have been implemented.[/h3]

[b]An exclusive Fractal Vice World Map has been added.[/b]
[list]
[*] During Fractal Vice challenges, an exclusive World Map can now be accessed.
[*] On the Fractal Vice World Map, you will be able to view accessible floors, as well as the obtain status of the treasure chests on each floor.[/list][b]Rift icons have been added to the radar.[/b][list][*] 2 Rift icons for moving to the next floor and 1 Rift icon for moving to the Boss Floor will be displayed.[/list][b]Rifts have been adjusted.[/b][list][*] There are now 3 types of Rifts on each floor for moving — "A", "B", and "Boss".
[list][*] "Boss" — Rifts that can take players to a Boss Floor with the corresponding level of that layer.
[*] "A" and "B" — Rifts found on each floor layer that can take players to a lower floor.
[*] Along with the above changes, there will be a total of 15 floors that will be allocated with treasure chests (Boss Floors excluded).[/list][/list][b]Boss Floors have been added.[/b][list][*] Once the Boss on a Boss Floor has been defeated, the Rift for returning placed at the far back of that floor can be accessed for returning.
[*] The Special Chests that were originally allocated at B5 will now be placed on Boss Floors.[/list]*Regardless of the layer on which the Boss Floor is challenged, a Special Chest can only be claimed 1 time per week.

[b]Treasure Chests distributed based on score.[/b][list][*] After defeating the Boss on the Boss Floor, Luxurious Chest(s) will appear in the far back of the Boss Floor based on the score received.[/list]
*The maximum number of Luxurious Chests that may appear after completing a single challenge is 30.
*Unlike chests in Fractal Vice, chests distributed based on scores have no weekly limit on the number that can be opened.

[b]Conditions to additionally increase obtained scores have been added.[/b][list][*] Scores can be increased greatly by reaching even lower floors.
[*] Scores can be increased greatly by engaging in an encounter with multiple enemies.[/list]
[b]The animation for score obtain has been adjusted.[/b][list]
[*] The obtained score will now display above the characters.[/list]
[b]Central Shaft has been added.[/b][list]
[*] By defeating the Boss located on B4 of Fractal Vice, you will gain access to a Rift in the far back that will take you to the Central Shaft.By defeating the Boss located on B4 of Fractal Vice, you will gain access to a Rift in the far back that will take you to the Central Shaft.  
[*] When taking on Fractal Vice, you will be able to move directly to the area with the Red Limit Series and challenge it by selecting "Move to 24 City: Central Shaft".
[*] In Central Shaft, the restrictions on functions such as party edit and recovery via Bloodstains will be lifted.
[*] Defeat the Red Limit Series Boss at the highest difficulty to obtain a corresponding medal.
[/list]*The Red Limit Series Boss that can be challenged in the Central Shaft will be updated on a weekly basis. If you have not unlocked the Central Shaft where the new Red Limit Series Boss is, you must do so by defeating the Boss on B4 of Fractal Vice again.
*Red Limit Series Bosses and difficulty levels will be added in an upcoming update.

[b]Selectable Red Limit Series Boss difficulties have been added.[/b][list][*] Players can now select the Challenge Lv when taking on Red Limit Series.
[*] No matter the number of Full Marks Stickers collected, the initial challenge will always be set to Lv 50.
[*] The next Challenge Lv will then become available upon completing the previous Challenge Lv.
[*] Available Challenge Lvs will only be applicable to the same Red Limit Series.
[*] Players can obtain a medal by defeating the Red Limit Series at the highest difficulty available.[/list]
[b]Time of revival for enemies holding keys to corresponding gates has been adjusted.[/b]
[list]
[*] Once enemies holding keys to corresponding gates on each floor have been defeated, they will not revive until the next Fractal Vice map update.
[/list]*Gates on Boss Floors are excluded.

[b]Notice prompt has been added.[/b][list]
[*] Players will see a prompt before proceeding if the levels of enemies on the next floor greatly exceed those of the party members in the current challenge. [/list]
[b]Tips have been added/updated.[/b][list]
[*] With this update, new Tips have been added, and some adjustments were made to existing Tips.[/list]
[b]Compatible Monster Sub Stats has been added.[/b][list][*] The following Sub Stats will be available on Compatible Monsters received in Fractal Vice.[list][*] Maximum HP IV++
[*] Attack IV++
[*] Defense IV++
[*] Support IV++
[*] Critical Rate IV++
[*] Critical DMG Multiplier IV++
[*] Grant Recovery Effect IV++[/list][/list][h3]The following events/campaigns will be available.[/h3][list]
[*] Fractal Vice - Hegemony Act 1
[*] Fractal Vice "Favored"
[*] Event: Restoration of Neo Tokyo[/list][h3]The following updates will be implemented.[/h3][list][*] Digital Energy Food (K), Digital Energy Food (M) and Digital Energy Food (G) can now be sold.
[*] A portion of Red Limit Series Bosses' "WARNING Attacks" will become "FATAL Attacks".
[*] On the Results screen in Boss battles, Challenge Lv will be displayed.
[*] The attack patterns of Death Penalty and Destroyer will be adjusted.
[*] The attack timing of Rakuzakai will be partially adjusted.
[*] Attack intervals of Tentacles will be partially adjusted.
[*] When battling Rakuzakai, the prioritization of ally character's Evasion timing will be adjusted.
[*] The abilities of Ferocious Enemy Deadly Red Alert will be lowered.
[*] The Battle BGM for some areas will be adjusted .
[*] Volume of some characters' voice effects when Chain Skills are triggered will be adjusted.
[*] On the mobile version, the default Graphic Settings will be set to "Low".
[*] For Rank Matches, players ranked at Bronze Rank ★1 - Silver Rank ★3 will be matched with opponents that are close in strength and of the same rank.[/list]
[b]Other minor adjustments have been implemented.[/b]

[h3]The following issues have been resolved.[/h3][list][*] In Ch. 3 Story XB, an effect may not display correctly and cause the XB game to suddenly go into the top of the fourth inning.
[list][*] *Depending on the XB Story progress, it may be possible to go into the top of the fourth inning properly.
[/list][*] In Ch. 3 Story XB, no matter her enhancement status, Tsuki Iroha will be included in the team as a Guest Character.
[*] In Ch. 0 Story Challenge, the game may not proceed correctly when executing Chain Skill under certain conditions.
[*] When battling the U-DX Robot, if the player pauses and locks a Tension Card, they may be returned to the Title Screen.
[*] Under certain conditions, even if the conditions for activating the effect of the Passive Skill Expansion 2 "Unseen Arrow" are met, the effect may not be activated.
[list][*] We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this issue and are issuing Enigma Entity x120 as compensation. Please claim the items from in-game Mail.[/list][*] When the party is equipped with Tension Card "Super Play", if "Toad Shot" granted through Ichinosuke Akiba's Strategy Skill "Akiba Ninjutsu: Conceal" triggers the effect of "Super Play", [Kingship] stacks will be gained till it reaches its maximum.
[*] When Q is being operated while wearing the Skin "Dominator", players will be returned to the Title screen instead when moving to the Battle Results screen.
[list][*] *Should this occur, the battle will be considered as cleared.[/list][*] When the character being operated is knocked out, they can continue to move temporarily under certain conditions.
[*] In a battle where multiple enemies are engaged in the encounter, on certain occasions, the game may be unable to progress when the effect of Tension Card "Close Attack" activates.
[/list]

[b]Other minor issues have been resolved along the update.[/b]

[b]For other bug fixes, please refer to related in-game notices posted after the release of Ver 1.1.1.[/b]

Please continue to enjoy TRIBE NINE.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/f8d3889bf0cff08643da2aec98a98885ca7d2cab.png[/img]


[h2]Preface[/h2]
Hello everyone, this is TRIBE NINE's director, Soejima.

First, I'd like to thank you everyone for your patience while waiting for this update. Today, I'm excited to introduce some of the changes coming in the major update Ver.1.1.0, as well as a roadmap for future plans.

[h2]About the Ver.1.1.0 Update[/h2]

[h3]Ch. 3 "Dead History Comes for Vengeance"[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c7a06910a74fbdb383a47151a6159dce808cc217.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/022883557230e81e37306d34c6280598544f1a4c.jpg[/img]

A new main story will be added.

The city that the Trash Tribe will visit this time is "Neo Chiyoda City."

As the name "Neo" suggests, it is not the same Chiyoda City from the anime, but rather a region slightly removed from the central area of the former Chiyoda City that serves as the anime's setting. 

In contrast to Chiyoda City's solemn atmosphere, you'll discover a unique world steeped in subculture.

[b]The New NUMBERS: Zenichi Magata[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d17f3537bfaa15726028ea62fc330f964147a5fc.jpg[/img]

In Neo Chiyoda City, a new NUMBERS, "Zenichi Magata (CV: Shigeru Chiba)," will appear before Yo and the others.

Unlike the NUMBERS they've encountered so far, Magata seems to be an opponent who strongly desires "Communication."

We hope you'll pay close attention to this new way of interacting with the NUMBERS and witness Trash Tribe's struggle as they navigate the unique XG of Neo Chiyoda City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/f9699c4a627980e00ed7d1003f623aaeda4cb5ae.png[/img]

Also, the mysterious Q, who seems to have a significant connection to Neo Chiyoda City, will be an important character in this chapter.

The events in Ch. 3 are partially connected to those in the anime. So, we highly recommend taking this opportunity to watch the TRIBE NINE anime's limited-time release, as it may allow you to enjoy the story even more deeply.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMsDHgwu-UmIxGnt5FaAbzeY6tGESp5jC]https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMsDHgwu-UmIxGnt5FaAbzeY6tGESp5jC[/url]


[b]About the Difficulty Level[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/126482806cd4c06a35fc58e612e7badbb42a2910.jpg[/img]

As a heads up, the enemy levels in Neo Chiyoda City will be higher than in previous areas. You may find battles challenging if you have just completed Ch. 2, so we recommend thoroughly upgrading your characters and cards before proceeding.

Starting with Ch. 3, we've reduced the number of "Full Marks Gates" that restrict story progression. Additionally, we've adjusted Ch. 1 and Ch. 2 to require fewer Full Marks Stickers, making it easier to enjoy the story.

On the other hand, routes that are considered "shortcuts" in Ch. 3 will have gates that require a higher number of Full Marks Stickers.
These routes will also feature higher-level enemies with challenging battles. We encourage you to unlock the new level cap, strengthen your characters, and explore Neo Chiyoda City after completing the main story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/842f71d264ecf3e6db5fb45b38fbc58050502b21.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, in Neo Chiyoda City, in addition to bosses and the story, new Patimon and Patimon Sub Stats will also be added.

The new PAR system—which we'll detail later in this letter—is designed to ensure your carefully selected Patimon remain valuable over time. We hope you'll enjoy experimenting with new combinations.

[h3]New Playable Character: Hinagiku Akiba[/h3]

[previewyoutube=cOv4EwqyEBU;full][/previewyoutube]

A new playable character, Hinagiku Akiba (CV: Kaede Hondo) joins the Synchro roster in update Ver.1.1.0!

At first glance, she seems like an ordinary(?) maid, but she appears to be related to the once prosperous "Otori Family." We hope you look forward to her role in Ch. 3.


[b]An Infighter Who Overwhelms Enemies with Her Powerful Primary Attack and Unique Deflect Mechanics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c4b40bdda80eb4cd4858170cbd0ff1ff3681b898.gif[/img]

Hinagiku's most distinctive feature is her "Charge Attack," which can be unleashed by press and holding her "Primary Attack."

This action also has an integrated offense and defense capability. If Hinagiku takes an enemy hit while charging her attack, an "Deflect Counterattack" will activate.

While this ability may seem overpowered, we want to note that the Deflect frames during a Charged Attack occur shortly after she begins charging, which means that if you want to be aggressive, you'll need to use regular "Deflects" effectively instead.

Hinagiku is a character who makes Deflects easy to perform, even for players less comfortable with timing Counterattacks. However, mastering her unique Deflect abilities unlocks her potential for massive damage output, making her versatile across different playstyles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d1524b52538af9aaf79ffefd0cf328b7a97f5bb2.gif[/img]

Hinagiku's Ultimate Skill consume Tension by 100 and inflicts "Attention" on all enemies. 

This effect allows Hinagiku to serve as a tank, protecting party members similar to Saigo and Q. This update will also introduce many additions that expand the synergy of "Hegemony" Tension Cards, so we hope you'll enjoy experimenting with different builds!

[h3]Rift Updates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d92ccfbb47eaebf030b9a563565e8b8ded8db787.jpg[/img]

We have received extensive feedback about the difficulty of enjoying Rifts and will be implementing significant improvements in response.

Starting with this update, new difficulty levels will be added to bosses and Rifts. Beyond these new difficulties, a bonus called "Highest Difficulty Bonus" will be added, allowing you to earn additional Kane and T Points.

Furthermore, similar to Lux-Phantasma's repeatable stages, a function will be added that allow players to consume up to three Boosters at once and double the number of reward draws you receive based on the number of Boosters consumed.


[h3]Changes to the PAR System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c2a16e3c51cf32292d44a94a400925afd16b8ad4.jpg[/img]

We will be changing the specifications for PAR to partially remove the Tier restrictions, so that Sub Stats will be inherited if the Tier is higher than the Patimon selected at the time of use.

We understand that this change may be met with mixed reactions due to the increased frequency of Kane consumption associated with using PAR.

However, we're making this change to maintain players' motivation to strategize with overworld Patimons, ensuring they receive similar attention to those obtained from Fractal Vice.

As mentioned earlier, we will continue to review and balance resource acquisition by increasing both sources and amounts of Kane, which should help reduce this stress in the future.


[b]Patimon Filtering Feature[/b]

A filtering feature for Patimons will finally be added! Thank you all for your patience while we worked on getting this feature implemented. 

We also plan on adding an automatic compression function in a future update.

[h2]Limited-time Shop[/h2]

As a brief side note unrelated to game content, we'll be adding a "Limited-Time Shop" that uses paid Enigma Entities in Ver.1.1.0.

Skins that were previously only obtainable from "Wonder Boxes" will now also be featured periodically in the shop for direct purchase. Keep an eye out—your favorite character's skin might be featured soon!

Additionally, we are planning to sell several items to help those who cannot spend much time playing the game progress efficiently.

[h2]Ver.1.1.1 Update Details[/h2]

[h3]About Fractal Vice - Hegemony[/h3]
As mentioned earlier, the current Fractal Vice has several issues that we plan to address through a major overhaul after Ver.1.1.0. 
Due to the extensive nature of these changes, we'll introduce them gradually.

The new Fractal Vice - Hegemony is scheduled to launch on April 24th, one week after the Ch. 3 update. We encourage you to first enjoy Neo Chiyoda City and the Ch. 3 story in Ver.1.1.0 before preparing to tackle the upcoming Fractal Vice.

Furthermore, we are planning an update aimed at improving Fractal Vice to coincide with the timing of Support Contract switches in the future.

In this update, we also plan to implement "Character Balance Adjustments" that we will discuss later in this letter.

We aim to maintain a balanced game environment long-term, enabling players to enjoy many kinds of team compositions.

[b]Separating the Red Limit Series from Fractal Vice[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/36ba11c9a376f5a8d596891d735756e38bef79cb.jpg[/img]

First off, battles with the Red Limit Series can only be challenged in a special space that can be accessed after clearing the deepest part of Fractal Vice, not within Fractal Vice itself.

Once you reach the space related to the target boss, you can move directly to that space without going through Fractal Vice from then on.

For example, after you clear the deepest floors of Fractal Vice and unlock Backgammon's room once, you can then always travel directly to Backgammon's room going forward.

If the active Red Limit Series boss changes to Solitaire, you will need to clear Fractal Vice's depths again to unlock access to Solitaire's room. However, if the boss later switches back to Backgammon, you can immediately challenge Backgammon directly when Fractal Vice resets.

Note: as the battles with the Red Limit Series have been separated from Fractal Vice, you can now rematch them at any time.


[b]New Map Feature Added[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/90abad8317c95a3033a2c885897fb2191b94e391.jpg[/img]

We've added an overall map screen where you can see the entire Fractal Vice. You can now check routes and the number of treasure chests you've obtained.


[b]Changes to Unlocking Gates[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7fcc944e3e9fa9158429596406ccce1ec43e949e.jpg[/img]

Within a given week's run of Fractal Vice, once you defeat the so-called "gatekeeper" enemies, the corresponding gate remains open for the rest of that week.

On floors you've already cleared once, this makes it possible to employ playstyles like quickly defeating remaining enemies efficiently in groups.

[b]Revised Structure and Difficulty[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/5e422141d72f4f0314a380c710555188f7e30398.jpg[/img]

In Hegemony, we are revising the overall difficulty—enemies will become significantly stronger as you venture into deeper layers.

We're also removing all "Rifts" for returning within the floors. To return, you'll need to clear the "Boss Floor" that matches your current difficulty level. 
You can access the Boss Floor from floors B1~B4, where you'll face a boss appropriate to your difficulty level.

Instead of Red Limit Series bosses, you'll encounter Ferocious Enemies and familiar foes like Brave Diver and S.H.A.R.K from your previous adventures. 
Some of these bosses may exceed the levels typically available in normal play, ensuring challenging battles even with familiar opponents.

[b]Changes to Scoring and Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/61bd8bcc779fa79cc123825879e2555598f7a5e8.jpg[/img]

Clearing a Boss Floor causes two types of chests to appear: "Luxurious Chests", with the quantity determined by your score at that point, and one "Special Chest", which can be obtained once per week.
Different from the chests found normally on the floors, these score-based "Luxurious Chests" can be earned repeatedly on subsequent clears.

This change aims to prevent a situation where players who could clear the original Fractal Vice without problems up to the deepest level might now only be able to clear up to floor B2 in Hegemony, which could result in a decrease in the total number of Patimon obtained or require more time for Patimon selection than before.

In addition to this, we are implementing several improvements to make it easier to select Patimon and to provide a greater sense of progression.

[b]Red Limit Series Improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4f35567e836c31966bc8917cac704e7fbeaeb849.gif[/img]

As mentioned briefly in the Fractal Vice section, the Red Limit Series will be repositioned as a separate challenge content, detached from conquering Fractal Vice. Therefore, the "Special Chest" that allows you to raise your character rank to EX+1 and beyond can now be obtained by clearing Fractal Vice without having to defeat the Red Limit Series.

As we mentioned in the previous Director's Letter, we position the Red Limit Series purely as challenge content, and this change aims to further clarify that policy.

Furthermore, for the Red Limit Series in Hegemony and going forward, difficulty selection will be added, similar to Rifts and boss farming. 
However, unlike the overworld, you will unlock higher difficulty levels by clearing the one before it.

We've prepared some exceptionally challenging optional bosses, available to fight once you've cleared Chapter 3. Defeating them on their highest difficulty setting rewards players with a unique Medal corresponding to each boss.

To put it another way, these bosses only drop their respective Medals – there are no other unique items or progression benefits tied to them. So, if you're focused on building your characters and following the story, you can absolutely skip these fights with no penalty.

[b]Fatal Attacks[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/9d8d69715cc71795f2d9832cf8b2a08859eb5cec.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/3f17344e373cdab7a0824fe4fe7fb60e3b90ae02.jpg[/img]

Also, starting with the Hegemony edition, including the existing Red Limit Series, "WARNING Attacks" will be replaced with a new attack called "Fatal Attacks."

If you are hit by this attack, you will be inflicted with a "Perilous State", which increases the damage you take for a certain period. Perilous State is a stacking effect, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. At maximum stacks, the multiplier becomes so high that the next hit will definitely knock you out.

The duration of one stack is not very long, so if you are hit by a Fatal Attack, we recommend playing it safe and prioritizing recovery from the Perilous State.

For players who have already figured out the attack patterns of Backgammon and Solitaire, this change should not significantly impact the gameplay feel. 
Even with builds centered around characters like Saigo, who specializes in damage reduction, it is still possible to withstand attacks and win as before if you properly deal with the "Fatal attacks."

[h3]About Game Balance[/h3]

In the Ver.1.0. environment, we designed the game assuming a base player level of 40, with Lv 50 being attainable only for those who had defeated the Red Limit Series.

However, shortly after launch, we made several changes to the game. These changes allowed many players to reach Level 50, and removing the card Tension consumption made players even more powerful. We now recognize that these adjustments have made enemies too weak to pose a meaningful challenge against players' increased firepower.

While we appreciate that this power progression reflects our players' dedication to strengthening their characters, it reveals a deeper issue. The current lack of gameplay depth means players don't feel sufficiently rewarded for character advancement.

With that in mind and based on our current development progress, we are continuously working on adjusting battles, starting with increasing the enemy difficulty in Ch. 3 and Fractal Vice.

With that said, we also recognize that for those who prioritize enjoying the story, this increase in difficulty may be causing more stress than intended.

Therefore, we plan to distribute the difficulty across the game's four main pillars: story progression, post-story content, Fractal Vice as endgame content, and then the Red Limit Series. In particular, we plan to adjust the difficulty of the "story progression" to make it smoother than the current experience. Furthermore, within Fractal Vice, we plan to establish clearer difficulty differences between floors B1~ B4.

Taking all of this into account, in the upcoming Ver.1.1.0, we will reduce the number of enemies in areas that are part of the main story progression. We will also make adjustments in future updates so that the battle difficulty in the Ch. 3 story progression is somewhat easier.

In particular, regarding the Ch. 1 boss, "S.H.A.R.K," while some players were satisfied with the challenge, we have confirmed that many others felt compelled to stop playing because of it. We hope to make it possible to enjoy the story comfortably as soon as possible.

[h2]Looking Ahead: Our Roadmap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/42b778fe6982d16c125cc6eef30e6c349a37c7c6.png[/img]

Starting with Ch. 3 and onwards, we plan to add new chapters and cities in a 3-month cycle to TRIBE NINE.

In April, the renewed Fractal Vice will appear one week after the release of Ver.1.1.0, and starting in May, a battle-focused event will be added. 
This event is designed to be slightly over-the-top, allowing even casual players experiment with different team combinations and see damage numbers beyond the usual range. It also provides challenging battles for hardcore Fractal Vice players, giving everyone the freedom to play at their preferred difficulty level.

This battle event, like "Lux-Phantasma," is also scheduled to be held for a longer period.

In addition to this, we plan to hold somewhat smaller events every 1 to 2 weeks. 

Regarding "Side Stories" including the current Lux-Phantasma, we have received a lot of positive feedback and are considering reorganizing the flow so that they can become permanent content in the future. 
This will be a rather large-scale change, so it will take some time to implement. However, we are preparing to share some news by the time the next Side Story is released, so please stay tuned for further updates.

[b]Improvements in Upcoming Updates[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/b32b7b3446da3df5ca84527e803698051dcb7766.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/2514183781b4507db621d505f1b35baa74ea45ac.jpg[/img]

We are also preparing updates that will improve the quality of life (QoL) for our players, including functional enhancements.

Among these, we have received a lot of feedback, particularly regarding Minato City, stating that "the map structure and connections are difficult to understand." In response, we are preparing an update that will renew the display of the radar and the overall map.

In addition to this, we are working on many other improvements, such as features that will make it easier to check synergy effects and buffs/debuffs during battles. We hope to announce these in this format in the future as well.


[b]About the Game Balance Update[/b]

Following the new chapter's release, we will implement regular balance updates focusing primarily on character adjustments.

These updates aim to strengthen underused characters, creating more diverse options for team compositions.

Characters that were released at launch will particularly need ongoing balance updates to keep them viable, since they tend to become weaker as the game evolves.

We've also received feedback that some characters' "Transcend" effects feel underwhelming. While we plan to strengthen these effects to make them more impactful, such adjustments require careful balancing. We ask for your patience as we work on these improvements.

With that said, we plan to implement some initial numerical adjustments to "Q", "Hyakuichitaro" and "Minami Oi" in Ver.1.1.0.


[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
That'll be all for this Director's Letter. 

Since the game's launch on February 20th, we initially received a lot of critical feedback. However, thanks to everyone's support, we were able to recover a "Very Positive" review on Steam. We'd like to extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone.

Beyond what we've introduced today, we have prepared several additional updates and improvements to enhance your adventures in Neo Tokyo.

We hope to continue providing you with further updates in the future, so we appreciate your patience.

In the upcoming Ver.1.1.0, we have prepared a major update that will significantly change the environment with a new city, new characters, and new Patimons.

A more dramatic development awaits Yo and the others' story as well.

We hope you will pay close attention not only to the new NUMBERS but also to the actions of "Q," who will be a key person in the upcoming story.


Let’s meet again in Neo Tokyo!

Please note that while some images show the Japanese UI, the actual game content will be in available in English.

notes.title: Director’s Letter – ♯006
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/f8d3889bf0cff08643da2aec98a98885ca7d2cab.png[/img]

[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Hello, I'm Soejima, the director of TRIBE NINE.
The game has undergone several minor updates recently. I'd like to apologize for not being able to properly introduce them due to the need to quickly implement these updates.
This letter will cover the following: Version 1.0.5 updates that were previously implemented, changes in the upcoming Version 1.0.10 update, along with new events and characters.

[h2]Implemented Updates in Version 1.0.5[/h2]

[h3]Fractal Vice and Zero Sensei Missions Updates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/6bae650ebd41a9e2aac07dbf34ffba739937f029.png[/img]

The Team received plenty of feedback related to "Fractal Vice" exploration, which is available after clearing the story.

We realize that the need to achieve multiple objectives such as unlocking level caps, carefully selecting Patimons, and defeating strong enemies right before an exploration ends all in one go can be frustrating for players.

As of now, we have adjusted the Zero Sensei Mission "Defeat Red Limit Series", which is necessary for unlocking character level cap till level 50, to "Win 15 battle(s) in Fractal Vice".

With this change, players can unlock level caps without having to defeat the Red Limit Series.

Though announcements were made on our official accounts, we were not specific enough. No adjustments will be made to the Red Limit Series. The difficulty will remain the same, so power up your parties and take on the challenge.

The Fractal Vice and Red Limit Series were designed for players who have considerably enhanced their parties and are looking forward to immersing themselves in the unique battle experience TRIBE NINE has to offer.

Therefore, the Team encourages players to view these as "a Challenge Letter from the Development Team which ultimately has no significant impact on overall game content".

However, when tackling Ch. 1 and Ch. 2, players were required to collect "Full Marks Stickers", which we believe might have subconsciously prompted players to consider such actions as a "task that must be completed".

In addition, we have overlooked players' needs to fully enhance the characters they own, when coupled with such limitations, players may have had a poor gameplay experience due to being unable to progress smoothly as a result of strong enemies blocking their way. We apologize for any inconvenience.

TRIBE NINE will continue to provide players experiences where they can enjoy highly challenging, action-packed battles to the fullest. And we will continue to strive in this direction. In addition, we will work hard to enrich game contents that meet the various play styles and needs of our players.

We have also received feedback regarding the time it takes for players to reach the Red Limit Series, as well as the whole process of challenging Fractal Vice again being too long. We are now working on relevant improvements.

As these changes would impact game content on a larger-scale, the adjustments are expected to be released together with the major Ch. 3 update.

We are sorry to have kept you waiting. Thank you for your understanding.


[h3]Adjustments to Battle Tempo[/h3]
Since the recent update, the following settings can be adjusted in Options.

[list]
[*] Can choose between "Normal/Weak" when adjusting Hitstop Intensity.
[*] Can toggle the Break Camera Effect "On" or "Off" for Break effects.
[*] Can toggle the Chain Skill Effect "On" or "Off" for Chain Skill effects.
[*] Can either adjust the Chain Reaction Time to "Standard" or "Short" to change the timing of Chain Skill execution after Break has been inflicted.
[/list]
By adjusting Hitstop Intensity, players will be able to enjoy the game at different tempos. Pick your favorite playing style.

Additionally, the game frequently switches between exploration and battle modes, leading to wait times as the game loads.

To reduce waiting time, we have shortened the transition time for returning to the Exploration screen after battles for players playing on devices with 6GB RAM or more in the last two updates.

We are currently reviewing the loading mechanism and hope to shorten the loading time even more.

[b]Experiencing "Lag" While Playing[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/387ce9c38cf8a44b7bf6af32a87d2a8c4b04b15a.gif[/img]

The Team has also received feedback regarding "lag" while playing.

We are aware that in an action game, if players are unable to cancel a character's actions while fighting with enemies and receive damage due to this restriction, there is still room for improvement.

Therefore, we plan to subsequently add executable time frames to each character to allow them to cancel their actions with Evasions or Counterattacks.

In this update, executable time frames are added for Yo Kuronaka and Miu Jujo, allowing them to execute Evasions when performing Secondary Attacks to cancel them out.

However, for characters that are difficult to operate yet are able to yield high rewards, such as Q and Enoki Yukigaya, the adjustments may cause them to lose their exclusive strengths. To allow each character to stand out uniquely, we may consider maintaining the current status quo and will continue to monitor the situation. We appreciate your understanding.


[h3]Enhancing Melee Characters[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/195e7cdb76ea927bc735e41cafd65eb5323fb88e.gif[/img]

The Team has also realized that fighting at close range may be relatively disadvantageous due to factors such as enemy Tension increase when receiving enemy attacks, or the shifting of Stamina.

Therefore, we have made the following two adjustments to strengthen some Melee characters.

[list]
[*] The Stamina Consumption of Deflect Counterattacks will be reduced from 500 to 250.
[*] Able to execute Evasions when performing Secondary Attacks to cancel them out.
[/list]
The adjustments aim to lower the risk of Melee characters as compared to Ranged characters when fighting in the front, allowing them to use Deflect proactively and launch attacks.


[h2]Expected Changes in the Version 1.0.10 Update[/h2]
Up next, we will be introducing the update content expected to be implemented together with next week's update.


[h3]Overall Buffing of Tension Cards[/h3]
We understand that the current conditions to activate Tension Card effects have given our players a less than satisfying experience due to the quick depletion of Tension; the usage of Tension Cards that can activate their effects at "Tension Phase: 0" has thus become more common. This has limited the combination of Tension Cards.

Given this, the Team has upgraded most Tension Cards by removing their Tension consumption in this upcoming Version 1.0.10 update.

While Tension consumption will be preserved or reduced for some Tension Cards, this adjustment should allow more cards to come into play.

Some parameters could be greatly enhanced as a result of this change. The Team anticipates that certain builds will reduce the difficulty of completing challenges.

With the upcoming Ch. 3, the Team will raise the difficulty of future battles slightly compared to our initial expectations, and cards with a lower usage rate will be further buffed.

For this same update, when engaging in encounters where the enemy has detected the player (i.e., a regular encounter), the Team is making adjustments to encounters so that players can start at Tension Phase: 2.

[h3]Retry Function with Lowered Difficulty[/h3]
To allow players to have an even better experience while taking on the battles tied to the story, the Team has added the option for players to be able to restart with lowered difficulty when being wiped out.

With a press of the button, players can restart a battle with their party members enhanced.

Enhancements can be repeated. If players are being wiped out constantly, try observing the enemies and try again.

Please note that the "Restart" button on the pause screen during battles does not offer the mentioned function.

[h3]Addition of "Daily Challenge" and "Delivery Request" Features to the Menu[/h3]
Since the release, we've received significant feedback regarding the addition of "Daily Challenge" and "Delivery Request" to the Menu. After this update, these two features will be included in the Menu.

Although a tiny update, the Team is glad that many players have been paying attention to the Branch Manager and others.

[h3]Reintroduction of the Fast Forward Feature[/h3]
The Skip (Fast Forward) button for dialogue events will be implemented.

We apologize for the constant adjustments to the content in previous Update Notes.

We are currently working on the recap function of the Story and XB with Numbers, and hope to introduce it in a future update.

[h3]Playing at 60 FPS on Mobile Versions[/h3]
Playing at 60 FPS on mobile versions is now available.

Please note that these settings may cause your device to overheat, increase power consumption, or slow down. We recommend players to consider carefully before applying them.


[h2]Upcoming Content[/h2]
Finally, I'd like to share about upcoming events and a new character.

[h3]XB Rank Matches[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/785671670979457c4d50040bf38cb590d33c6351.gif[/img]

On March 6, we will be opening XB "Rank Matches" for all players who have registered team mates for XB to enjoy.

Determined by the result of matches, player rankings will focus on matching players with similar levels of enhancement.

To that end, we have developed this game aspect to allow for casual gameplay when players are looking for a break from battling and exploring, as opposed to an intense and ruthless competitive mode.

There is no function for inspecting rank details. Rather, players will be able to obtain rewards through simply playing against one another, regardless of match results.

PvP XB matches are not like the matches against the NUMBERS, where powerful corrections are made possible through the results of debates. A player's performance will instead be reflected in how they've enhanced their team and decisions rooted in baseball.

As this is a play style focused on using Characters players have trained, we hope this will be an opportunity for players to enjoy showing off their statuses to each other.

One more thing to keep in mind, at the start of a Rank Match Season, players will start at the same rank. This means there is a chance players may be put in a series of intense matches where there is a sizable enhancement gap.

We anticipate that this is something that will be improved over time and appreciate your patience.

[h3]New Character: Kazuki Aoyama[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7432a689f273b05134c984187084ea053fb9b3f0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d06c8804e4806333d1d52a818a79f707dbd56707.gif[/img]

Making his debut for the new Synchro in Version 1.0.10, we have Kazuki Aoyama.

Kazuki Aoyama is a multi-faceted character who can grant party members Shields, can launch Additional Attacks, and has a high Break ability.

Additionally, compared to Kazuki's various abilities, this character features incredibly simple mechanics, making him easy to operate.

While this might seem like an all-powerful character at first glance, all of these actions require a resource: "Memory".

At the beginning of a battle, Memory will be at full capacity. This resource will be consumed as Kazuki Aoyama executes his Strategy Skill and Secondary Attack.

This means he could "run low on energy" during a long fight, making it difficult to utilize his strength.

A certain amount of Memory can be recovered when he executes his Ultimate Skill. If the amount of Memory obtained exceeds the maximum amount, Kazuki will enter an "Overclock" state.

This state increases Attack and allows the character to be leveraged as an Attacker.

Also, compared to when Kazuki was brought in as a Guest in Ch. 2, the character has undergone minor buffs, adjustments to how he handles, and overall fine-tuning.

These changes will be reflected in the Guest version of the character when Synchro is updated. 

[h3]New Event: "Lux-Phantasma"[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/38847b399244bb0f7208fb1f760924c6af27824a.jpg[/img]

The last thing the Team would like to share with you is an upcoming event called, "Lux-Phantasma".

This Story Event in TRIBE NINE does not focus on battling but instead proceeds completely through minigames.

In Lux-Phantasma, players will be able to enjoy a rhythm game that features Tsuruko Semba as the protagonist.

One interesting point about this event is that "Boosters" can be consumed freely.

Rewards are obtained differently compared to repeating challenges in the Rift, so players will be able to take a break from battling as they play.

For this event, players will progress the story through this unique setup, and much like Fractal Vice, rewards are obtained by accumulating points while playing the event

Please note that Lux-Phantasma will be unlocked after completing Ch. 2.

We anticipate having the event period continue for quite some time, so players can join in the fun after completing the story, without the need to rush.


[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
This is the end of my letter to you, the players.

Since the release of TRIBE NINE, we have received lots of feedback from you all.

While we have been shown areas where we need to improve, we've also heard how players are enjoying our game. All of this serves to make TRIBE NINE an even better game, and we are so grateful!

We are also in the midst of a busy update and realize that this means the contents of our game have yet to settle. We appreciate everyone's understanding.

Several areas have yet to be adjusted to their finest, particularly Synchro, our setup for rewards that can be obtained through gameplay, as well as Tension Cards. We realize that this may result in a gameplay experience that does not fully rise to players' expectations.

The Team will be focusing our efforts on making adjustments quickly. We hope that our players will look forward to the Ch. 3 update as we prepare several other updates in parallel.

Please continue to have fun playing TRIBE NINE.

Let's meet again in Neo Tokyo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/e895eeb82c70a081aec148605cf0794d55f1046b.gif[/img]

notes.title: [Important Notice]Changes to Synchro Rates and More Places to Get Synchro Medals
notes.content:
Thank you for playing TRIBE NINE.

Since the game launched, we have received player feedback about Synchro appearance rates as well as the distribution of Enigma Entities and Synchro Medals. 

We understand that we have shaken players' confidence in our game by not fully considering the amounts of various obtainable items.

After reviewing and discussing your feedback, we have decided to implement the following:
・Adjust the appearance rates for Synchro
・Return Enigma Entities and Synchro Medals that have been consumed to perform Synchro
・Add more places to obtain Synchro Medals
・Modify the appearance rates for Pickup on the 80th Event Synchro

■ Adjustments to Synchro Appearance Rates

After the maintenance on March 3rd, 2025 (7:00 PM ~ 10:00 PM PST), all Synchro rates will be adjusted as follows:

★3: 0.6% → 2% (Pickup Target: 0.3% → 1.5%, non-Pickup Target: 0.3% → 0.5%)
★2: 5.1% → 8% (Pickup Target : 1.7% → 6%, non-Pickup Target: 3.4% → 2%)
★1: 94.3% → 90%

■ Returning Enigma Entities and Synchro Medals consumed for Synchro

Along with these adjustments, Enigma Entities and Synchro Medals used up until March 3rd, 2025 at 7:00 PM PST will be returned after the maintenance on March 3rd, 2025 (7:00 PM ~ 10:00 PM PST).

*Regardless of whether the Enigma Entities or Synchro Medals were used on Event Synchros or the Standard Synchro, all such items consumed will be returned.

*Paid Enigma Entities and Free Enigma Entities will be returned respectively based on the type of Entity the player has consumed.

Enigma Entities and Synchro Medals consumed up will be returned via in-game Mail.

The Synchro Count for the 80th Synchro to have a "guaranteed ★3" will not be reset.

Additionally, the "guarantee to receive a ★3 Pickup on the next Synchro" will continue if the last ★3 obtained was not a Pickup.

*Please note that the Enigma Entities used for other purposes, such as purchasing Support Contracts or leveling up Contracts will not be returned. 

■ Additional places to obtain Synchro Medals

After the maintenance on March 3rd, 2025 (7:00 PM ~ 10:00 PM PST), Synchro Medal x1 will be added to the Completion Reward for each City Challenge.

*For those who have already completed City Challenges up until March 3rd, 2025 at 7:00 PM, Synchro Medals will be given in compensation based on the challenges completed. 

*Compensated Synchro Medals will be sent via in-game Mail.

■ Adjustments to the Pickup appearance rate for the accumulated 80th pull for Event Synchros

The details for ★3 Guarantee on the accumulated 80th pull for Event Synchros can be found in "Event Synchro: Character Details" and "Event Synchro: Tension Card Details".

We apologize if this has caused any misunderstanding among our players.

After the maintenance on March 3rd, 2025 (7:00 PM ~ 10:00 PM PST), the appearance rates for ★3 Pickup Targets in Event Synchros will be adjusted to 75% as seen below.

[Guaranteed ★3 on the accumulated 80th pull in Event Synchro]
★3 Appearance Rate: 100% (Pickup Target: 75%, Others: 25%)

[Before accumulating 79 pulls in Event Synchro]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4a38f7f23b698b7315a8b79778f9469eca42df73.jpg[/img]

[h2]◆Defy the Madness: Brutal Action RPG "TRIBE NINE" Global Release![/h2]

TRIBE NINE was officially released globally on Thursday, February 20th, 2025. Set in Neo Tokyo, a nation ruled by brutal death games, TRIBE NINE is an action RPG that tells the story of teens battling against madness and continuing their resistance.

The game offers challenging battles that allow players to devise their own strategies through various character build features and combat maneuvers. Alongside these battles, the game reveals a narrative of resistance against a brutal death game.

Immerse yourself in a story that reflects the depth and quality of Japanese-style creations, complemented by a deeply engaging and immersive gameplay experience, all free to play with in-app purchases.

Experience a humorous yet sometimes brutal story, brought to life by the unique world of “Neo Tokyo” with its memorable, well-crafted characters.

[h2]◆New Trailer Release, “Gameplay Trailer: Minato Chapter”![/h2]

We're excited to present the latest TRIBE NINE "Gameplay Trailer: Minato Chapter."

The trailer focuses on “Minato City” from the main story Chapter 2 which is now available in the official release version. 

Watch the trailer to discover the mysterious face that #9 conceals beneath its hood.

▼ Gameplay Trailer: Minato Chapter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4c9489631297232b9cfe6cea1ca28825b7765fd3.png[/img]

▼ About Minato City

Main Story Chapter 2 takes place in the former headquarters of the anime's main characters, Minato City.
The city is ruled by a death game in which residents compete for rank based on their "Dominance," which is determined by the various values each person possesses, such as their social status, capabilities, connections, and self-presentation.
In this ruthless system, residents risk their lives battling for Dominance, falling out of the rankings due to a significant drop in Dominance power results in severe punishment.
When our protagonist, Yo Kuronaka, and his companions set foot in Minato City, they are faced with a new powerful enemy, #9.
As they explore famous landmarks like “Minato Tower” and “Shiba Temple,” Yo and his companions must face a new death game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/a1a93852cd390e3a341071369277952601196ff5.png[/img]

During the Support Contract period, you can increase your "Contract Level" by completing missions and collecting a certain number of "Support Contract Certificates".
As you collect Support Contract Certificates, your Contract Level increases, unlocking various rewards at each level milestone.
In the "Support Contract - Transmelt Edition" that will be available from the official release, in addition to the free "Basic Support", you can also upgrade to the next level by purchasing "Armed Support" or the highest level "Advanced Support" with Paid Enigma entities.
If you upgrade your Support Contract to "Armed Support," a "Limited Skin" and a "Limited ★3 Tension Card" will be added to the rewards you can obtain by reaching certain Contract Levels.
If you upgrade even further to the higher level, "Advanced Support," you can also get a "Limited Name Card Banner" immediately after upgrading.

[b]New Chain Skill activation system.[/b]
Chain Skills now activate when you break an enemy's Posture instead of using the old Impairment system.
Keep attacking an enemy to weaken their Posture. Once it's fully broken, you can use a Chain Skill.

[b]The battle system's Tension Gauge can now only be filled by performing chain skills.[/b]

[/list]

[h3]New conditional skills and effects have been added[/h3]

<Super Play>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7eadd040929f4e47b46cbca3973c60a95296e5ab.jpg[/img]

During XB, you can perform "Super Plays" based on your allocated Potential and story progression.

<Extreme Play>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d359db1eca9faf04557b0e20d2eadbfd3bc09c0a.jpg[/img]

You'll get "Extreme Factors" when something really unique and hard to pull off happens in a match. If you have any of these factors, you can do "Extreme Plays" when your Tension is high.

You can see if you have any "Extreme Factors" by looking at the icon at the top of the screen.

[b]When characters get enough buffs from Super or Extreme Plays, they'll glow with an aura.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/9a79bf322e90573a7442bdf35f36bc0bb956d3b6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/917d8ad0921fe4d6f70f8f7d85120f3ebf3d70f4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Pitching-hitting screen has been updated[/h3]
[b]When you choose a command, the minimap will now show you where the ball is going and which skill will be used.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/48098823e57187159a4706d24f4ec63bf81a57b0.jpg[/img]

In the Deadly Demo, the minimap only showed the likelihood of the ball direction and skills, but now in the full game, it will show you exactly what's going to happen.

Also, if you see a character icon on the minimap, that means they're guaranteed to use their Super or Extreme Play.

[b]After each turn, both you and the enemy will gain some Tension.[/b]

[b]At-bats will automatically be skipped under certain conditions.[/b]
When an at-bat doesn't really matter, you'll skip the commands and see a quick recap instead!

[b]Added a "Log" button to the pitching/batting screen so you can keep track of what's happened in the game.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/551253b03f12fa048ba9859070c7c4c0dcf36775.png[/img]

[h3]The following changes have been made to Story XB progression:[/h3]

[b]The objective will now be displayed.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/5b9a9a6f8aa33829649a324d327335a26459cc78.jpg[/img]

[b]After selecting a command, a debate between the characters will begin.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4763c4603a1248ecd358cffccac4d0c3b0f9918d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/e10719dce9ccb6dcb8ea534ea08ecaff244c4564.jpg[/img]

Also, we've added a new dialogue system where your command choices can change how conversations go. Picking the right answers can lead to more interesting interactions and help you learn more about the characters.

This feature is only available in Story XB.

[b]"Verity Orbs" have been significantly updated.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/a3a481b9dbbc08366adae16d038ca4fd54dc2213.jpg[/img]

▶ Unlike the demo, you'll now need to complete all the Verity Orb Challenges before starting Story XB.
This means you'll start Story XB with every Verity Orb ready to use.

▶ When you get a chance to use a Verity Orb in Story XB matches, you'll need to choose the right one from your collection.

[h3]Made some balance changes to Story XB in Story Challenge Ch. 0 and Ch.1[/h3]

[h3]You can now check out the details of Extreme Plays and see how your "Potential" is developing on both the XB Formation screen and the map. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/e27756fb6317cefccef7d93b26baea1aa9dbc015.png[/img]

[h3]Multiplayer mode for XB has been added[/h3]

<Casual Match>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/e6fb27cc25c4a8570e4c0bcabc1c7a99f502a264.jpg[/img]

You'll unlock "Casual Match" mode after you beat Story Challenge Ch. 2 "The Monster Within".

[h3]A new XB mode that lets you compete against a special NPC team.[/h3]

<??????>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/9408290653120a9db850eff0435dcabadeb9dc77.jpg[/img]

Unlike Story XB, this mode is all about competitive XB gameplay with a higher difficulty.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/9feafa39445bc2d27d3db6f21efc0c554b8b731f.jpg[/img]

[h3]We've made some changes to how the exploration screen looks and how the HUD is laid out.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/1b52e9dd08c7a08ea127d0531e8bf5e8e0b255a7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/f98e0732c05dbf7dbba9d77c836d159a7334de3b.jpg[/img]

[h3]New feature added: "Full Marks Gate".[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/20e7e2d6b1bc571f78b7c6b7f09a3dda32cf90b0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7bc0ded185a3f8953aa89fa239c9732752c0da78.jpg[/img]

As you progress through the game, you'll sometimes come across special "Full Marks Gates" that block your path. These gates mark a point where the game gets harder.

To open these gates, you'll need to level up your characters until they're strong enough. So, when you encounter a Full Marks Gate, it's a good idea to focus on powering up your party.

[h3]The following safe zones have been added:[/h3]

<Patimate>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d2477b2c856a93263d2a6397dcda6c9d5e6f1a93.png[/img]

<Antenna Shop "Parabola">

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/a29d4893bddbe9ba6e7b948f999bcdeb9e345ea1.png[/img]

<Card Station Ω>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/85c83edb4b773c343a0fcb9191136da54976e49d.png[/img]


[h3]Renamed the old dungeon system to "Rift" and made some changes and additions to it.[/h3]

[b]Objects and treasure chests that contain items have been added, and enemies will now drop Compatible Monsters and training materials.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c0caf2d4f629ee34910fff6cfb111ec2cb35970e.jpg[/img]

Rifts are smaller areas where you can find more materials for leveling up your characters than in other places.
They also have special items that you can only get in that specific city.
Think of Rifts as a good place to stock up on stuff without having to spend ages exploring.


[b]With the removal of the stamina system (formerly called energy), which will be discussed later, dungeons can now be accessed using "Boosters" instead.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c88d6ff876b846a029e1b04518dc58c58dc5363e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/222b1c8e6e494cf4a9e6692de1d0802166a5fdaf.png[/img]

You can get Boosters by completing daily missions and challenges in Support Contracts (more on that below), or by defeating enemies.
If you have some Boosters to spare, use them to activate Rifts and speed up your character growth.

[b]The Rift's difficulty level adjusts based on your Full Marks Sticker count.[/b]

[b]While exploring a Rift, you can now check your character information and change your party formation. [/b]

[b]You can now exit a Rift at any time.[/b]
Your progress will be saved, and you can resume where you left off by re-entering the Rift.

[b]New Rifts has been added to "Shinagawa City.”[/b]

[h3]A new "Lobby" area has been added[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/87aac73804601438913bbfad36870622ffcd7388.png[/img]

After you complete Story Challenge Ch. 2 "The Monster Within", you can enter the Lobby from any Respite Unit.
In the Lobby, you can take on "Fractal Vice" challenges.
You can also chat with characters and give them gifts.

[h3]New puzzles have been added[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4277baab169bdc89c827395c2d4ba00087d7ed19.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/eced221442b0e389b7909c64b4191ecca22926b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/60fd10ef6356d33e181919abe705100ce1e64aa2.jpg[/img]

[h3]You can now recover some of your HP by checking out other players' "Wipeout History".[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/b14495a106c2a6a3820f444272834128783d5598.jpg[/img]

[h3]In some areas of each city, you might run into "Ferocious Enemies" that will chase after you. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/cd1d0cc7e40d666c88506bfb00d9f4907110068d.jpg[/img]

These ferocious enemies will respawn in a new spot if - you defeat them, your team is wiped out, or a certain amount of time passes.

[h3]"Rare Enemies" that give a lot of experience points will show up in different places around each city.[/h3]
Each day, a rare enemy will appear in a random spot within a certain area.

[h3]Characters will now speak in more situations, like when they're idle or when certain things happen in the game.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/dae75dd48c10670ef3eebf80760f26ca172cafea.jpg[/img]

[h3]You'll now find breakable objects scattered throughout each area.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4b20fecb18eab9ac83e0df183af98c805f1e7190.jpg[/img]

[h3]We've made the following changes to the Graffiti-finding challenges:[/h3]
▶ Added a lot more graffiti to the city!
▶ Finding graffiti is now part of the "Zero Sensei" missions.
▶ Collect all the graffiti by one artist to earn extra rewards.

[h3]Treasure Chests now respawn after a certain amount of time[/h3]
The respawn time is determined by the chest's rarity.

[h3]Enemy behavior during exploration has been adjusted.[/h3]
▶ Enemies will now wander within areas.
▶ You can now see enemy detection ranges.
▶ Running past enemies can alert them, regardless of their detection range.
▶ Spotting the player alerts nearby enemies, who will then pursue.
▶ If you're much stronger, enemies may run away!
▶ Enemies won't disappear when you change screens.

[h3]You'll now get a special alert when you pick up a Tension Card during exploration.[/h3]

[h3]The following additions have been made to the World Map:[/h3]
[b]You will now get notifications about elements resetting over time.[/b]
[list]
[*] When Daily Challenges are available.
[*] When Delivery Requests complete.
[*] When Fractal Vice rewards refreshed.
[/list]

[h3]New types of map icons have been added.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/9c1ed84f7585b3e166a4b5773013aa8ac1a98499.png[/img]

[h3]You can now check your Verity Orbs collection progress.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4063bacbca87b7f5021beaaea4b14d316d180ae2.jpg[/img]

[h3]The game's sound design has been enhanced.[/h3]
[b]You'll feel more immersed in Neo Tokyo with the addition of new music and ambient sounds.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/b11f78ac49eb85ae66f6bc13fceb4d09e4672423.jpg[/img]

[h3]The "Skin" feature has been added.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/277b017c15888e22c24d70d567e0bbaf703817e9.jpg[/img]

[b]Limited Skins have been added[/b]

<Transmelt>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c6005e37967ac11c9dc8354b5167e8b1e05fb9e0.jpg[/img]

<Agastus Gear>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/df977827ae502a32485aa0594a103973827826c3.jpg[/img]

<Parallel Cypher>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/2be13a6da54b6aa31403afe395b806a5d4552236.jpg[/img]


[b]Special skins have been added for some characters.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/194bb3ff836c5fe52cd36779bb78eb8563377a7a.jpg[/img]

[b]Color variations for some skins have been added.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/3515749cc2fe4126239abd8fd82df3ae6dbfaacc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/fb7fc780bb0782fc0700132f66235c5603661301.png[/img]

[h3]New item added: "Wonder Box"[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7f270bd79eb98326effcbce71c2670817dd54e1e.jpg[/img]
Skins and Profile Banners can now be obtained.
Wonder Boxes can be earned from various in-game activities.

Kazuki Aoyama skins will be available for purchase in "Patimate" upon his release.
These skins will also be available in "Wonder Boxes" after the next major update.

[h3]"Delivery Request" feature has been added.[/h3]

[b]Players can request and receive training materials from one another.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/0c64f8e95dc5eda6dbab59dae66b80774a1412f1.png[/img]

[b]Fulfill item requests from other players to earn Enigma Entities.[/b]

[h3]The "First-Aid Kit" is now called "First-Aid Item," with new types and modifications.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/c029f870704f24b4cad47382418f0889f87c4eeb.png[/img]

Dishes from the Deadly Demo are now included in "First-Aid Items".
Some "First-Aid Items" can be synthesized with the proper recipe.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/8e649518c5f474e3bfed6b90e9c3fc73d136dffa.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Compatible Monsters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Barbarian
[*] Megalodon
[*] Knight
[*] E.X.E
[*] Kobold
[*] Magi
[/list]
...And more have been added to the game!

[h3]The leveling system for Compatible Monsters has been removed.[/h3]

[h3]Compatible Monsters can now be found in treasure chests and as enemy drops.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/a794db094db391aacc4da11924308dfe9c48f7fa.jpg[/img]

You'll get a special visual effect when you discover a Patimon while exploring.

[h3]We've overhauled the Sub Stats system.[/h3]
*Since all Sub-Stats have been adjusted, details are not included in these patch notes.

[h3]Set Effects have been added / changed.[/h3]
Please check the in-game notification for further details.

[h3]The more Full Marks Stickers you have, the higher the tier of Compatible Monsters you'll find.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7d5c156496862eba1f07ecfb481c11826b71c473.jpg[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/3931a788c3760dd1834ce79f59eba648b7cd543d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Available on mobile (iOS/Android)[/h3]
Player data can now be shared across platforms.
Paid Enigma Entities you've purchased will also be available on other platforms.

[h3]Korean has been added to the language options[/h3]

[h3]"Paid Enigma Entities" are now available for purchase[/h3]

[h3]A new shop has been added[/h3]

[b]Daily Pass[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/3ec6ce122b1daebdbc415b1284f6be433e07d560.png[/img]

[b]Enigmatic Token Exchange[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/1ce9a8d01b19d2e5ec311380423ebf6301b5ed50.png[/img]

Exchange your Enigmatic Fragments, Engimatic Remnants, and Enigmatic Pieces for rewards.

[h3]The stamina system (formerly Energy) has been removed.[/h3]

[h3]"Support Contract" feature has been added.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/197ec7a34bc62deef674d879f03bfed75515d77b.png[/img]
Support Contracts are similar to a battle pass: Complete gameplay missions to earn rewards.
Two types of Support Contracts exist: Basic and Armed. All players receive Basic rewards.
Armed Support costs "Paid Enigma Entities" and unlocks extra rewards, including exclusive Tension Cards and Skins.

[h3]"Friendship Level" feature has been added.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/5c23d1d5a7690fc8b662a4582da33a6ddf39abf8.jpg[/img]

Each character has a Friendship Level.
Increase Friendship Levels by using characters in battle and gifting them in the Lobby.
Note: Friendship Levels have no effect on character abilities.

[h3]When you acquire a new character, you’ll now see a new special animation.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/df30ddef776535bee8c9f6c6792f7b69072a50a4.jpg[/img]

[h3]The following changes have been made to "Synchro":[/h3]

[b]Standard Synchro pulls can now be done using "Synchro Medals".[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/2f1690dfc07d45fcb3ff552ea2a3e3251e0c6be9.jpg[/img]

[h3]After 300 "Embarking Companionship" pulls, you'll unlock a "Special Invitation" that guarantees a ★3-star character from the same Syncro.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/7ce68fc8bd7beee8f6388e3b974b944180625fd4.png[/img]
This reward can only be claimed 1 time per account.

[h3]You can try out characters in battles based on the current Synchro rotation.[/h3]

[h3]Steam achievements have been added.[/h3]

notes.title: The official global release is set for Thursday, February 20th, 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4c331551ea17546970a8aad5755b828b127f86ab.png[/img]

TRIBE NINE is scheduled for a global release on Thursday, February 20th, 2025. Set in Neo Tokyo, a nation ruled by brutal death games, TRIBE NINE is an action RPG that tells the story of teens battling against madness and continuing their resistance.

The game offers challenging battles that allow players to devise their own strategies through various character build features and combat maneuvers. Alongside these battles, the game reveals a narrative of resistance against a brutal death game.

Immerse yourself in a story that reflects the depth and quality of Japanese-style creations, complemented by a deeply engaging and immersive gameplay experience, all free to play with in-app purchases.

Experience a humorous yet sometimes brutal story, brought to life by the unique world of "Neo Tokyo" with its memorable, well-crafted characters.


[h3]◆The latest trailer has been released, focusing on the protagonist, Yo Kuronaka, and his companions as they fight against the madness![/h3]

The "<Ver1.0> Release Trailer" for TRIBE NINE is now available. Stay tuned for more intense action scenes, where the high-quality 3D models of the characters bring the battles to life.
[previewyoutube=NmTOV4W1brQ;full]https://youtu.be/NmTOV4W1brQ[/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/4dd089bebf310210e61292b3cbe974e0858189ce.jpg[/img]

TRIBE NINE will keep expanding the main story and city through updates after its official release.

[h3]◆Check out the latest Director's Letter for more improved features in the upcoming release! [/h3]

The dev team has made significant changes to the game features based on the feedback received from the players who played during the demo and closed beta test. Features such as battle mechanics, core gameplay, character development, and XB Battles have notably evolved. Director Soejima will share more details in the next "Director's Letter" series update.

The Company will not pursue copyright claims against derivative works that comply with these guidelines.

notes.title: TRIBE NINE Update Notes!
notes.content:
Thank you for your participation in the Deadly Demo.
To improve gaming experience, we have made adjustments to various aspects of the game, such as battling elements, difficulty, and story progression, according to the feedback we received from the Global Beta Test "Deadly Playtest".

[h3]Regarding Battles[/h3]
[b]▶︎New playable characters.
Kazuki Aoyama[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/1f9772b4749c28dc5f721552132e19225673bf82.jpg[/img]
An all-rounded character that is easy to operate and can transform his weapon. Fights on the front line, granting Shield and triggering allies' Chain Skills.


[b]Hyakuichitaro Senju[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/b11f0e2ac335d68d7b885ff901b79430a3a22b08.jpg[/img]
A character that charges [Fighting Spirit] by attacking repeatedly. Can grant allies Shield that transfers damage taken to him.

[b]▶︎New Tension Cards.
Things To Hold On To[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/33942bba211caf18d6bf587d1ee5c3694a683052.jpg[/img]
When a character is granted Shield and hits the enemy with a Deploy Action attack, this Tension Card will grant that character a buff that will increase the Attack point of their Ultimate Skill.

[b]All Out[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/a375f07218f0a49d8923feb9afea5aaf83639791.jpg[/img]
This Tension Card is suitable for players who are confident with their skills. When executing Actions, Evasion Gauge will be consumed to increase Damage Bonus.

[b]▶︎Removed conditioning of enemy difficulty in accordance to players' enhancement levels.[/b]
During the Deadly Playtest, we implemented a setting which allows players to have an easier time defeating enemies when the enhancement levels reach a certain standard.
However, many players prioritized countering enemy movements over enhancing their characters. This often led into the situation in which "enemies are irrationally strong when characters are underpowered." Hence, we decided to remove this setting. 
We hope that through this adjustment, the enhancement level of players will not affect their damage output; and that they will be able to immerse themselves into the clashing of different movements even more.

[b]▶︎Added new Action - "Dash"[/b]
Characters will be able to move through the battlefield swiftly through dashing. Under this status, it is possible to keep at a distance from the enemy and reposition oneself.

[b]▶︎Adjustments to the Evade Action[/b]
We will be introducing a new system - the "Evasion Gauge" in Deadly Demo. When executing evasion, a certain amount of the Evasion Gauge will be consumed.
[list]
[*] The Evasion Gauge will slowly recover even when an Action is executed.
[*] Executing an evasion when there is insufficient amount of Evasion Gauge will deplete the Evasion Gauge completely; and the gauge will only start to recover after the additionally consumed amount is refilled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/e290cf000c21a8e66fca53bd1345a1cfcee3d5c5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[/list]
[*] The Maximum Evasion Gauge will vary for different characters. For more information, please head to the Character Screen to confirm.[list]
[*] Enhancing the potential "Survival Instincts" can increase the Maximum Evasion Gauge.[/list][/list]

[b]▶︎Adjustment to targets during battles.[/b]
To optimize battle experience, we have made adjustments to the camera.
We will also be adjusting the lock-on function so that it would be even more convenient to differentiate targets.
In the options, players will be able to freely adjust between prioritizing targets the character is facing, or the target closest to the operating character.
[list]
[*] Targeted enemies will now be marked.
[list]
[*] An enemy that will be targeted after being attacked will be marked with the "〇" marker.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/b4fafd55026ddb8f745e05d1a72354b0193ed447.jpg[/img]
[*]An enemy automatically targeted by the camera will be marked "◎".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/abff60f288161817f2e88d1b710fbdd144da6448.jpg[/img]
[/list][/list]

[b]▶︎Adjustments to camera during battles.[/b]
We've added a function which will allow the camera to capture enemies automatically even if they are outside the frame.
[list][*] Players can adjust the camera distance or disable the function in the options.[/list]

[b]▶︎Adjustments to chain skills.[/b]
It is now easier to trigger Chain Skills. When an Impairment is granted, even if it does not fulfill the condition to trigger a Chain Skill, the Chain Skill will still have a chance to be triggered.
[list]
[*] Enhancing the potential "Combo Ability" will increase the chance to trigger Chain Skills.
[*] The icons will now mark required Impairments
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/b8b63b3fdf8af124beef1078cc6749713cc9c2dc.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]▶︎Adjustments to Deflect.[/b]
Upon a successful Deflect, Tension Gauge will increase.
[list]
[*] The time frame to determine if a Deflect is successful has been adjusted, making a Deflect easier to execute.
[*] Skill icons will be marked if they can be used to Deflect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/d3e736cebaea7de6abebf1a3e294ee6d33ddd6b0.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]▶︎Command List is now accessible through Character screen or battle screen.[/b]
The Action command list for every character is now available.
[list]

[/list]

[b]▶︎Foreboding signals before enemy attacks enhanced.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/a5ee8d3e443f7d79a794f710242e4305547f69ef.jpg[/img]
[b]▶︎Detailed battle rewards can now be confirmed.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048327/ede1099d4827057914357ced9b41c34a26bf7994.jpg[/img]
